structure.unit: General Powers and Procedures of Counties

law.catch_line: Regulation of certain motion pictures shown at drive-in theaters
law.text: Any county may, by ordinance, regulate the screening of motion pictures, classified by the motion picture industry as being suitable for display to adult audiences only, in drive-in theaters where such motion pictures are visible to the traveling public from a highway, street or other public way for the purpose of protecting the health, safety and welfare of the public.
